source_dataset.name: PlantDoc: A Dataset for Visual Plant Disease Detection
source_dataset.citation: Singh, D., Jain, N., Jain, P., Kayal, P., Kumawat, S., & Batra, N. (2020). PlantDoc: A Dataset for Visual Plant Disease Detection. Proceedings of the 7th ACM IKDD CoDS and 25th COMAD, pp. 249-253.

metadata.policy: Strict taxonomic auditing. Classes where PlantDoc's web-scraped label aggregates multiple causal pathogens beyond PlantVillage's single-pathogen definition are marked AMBIGUOUS_BROAD_DISEASE_DEFINITION and excluded under strict mode (--strict-taxonomy).

Apple Scab Leaf.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence between field apple scab leaves and PlantVillage Apple___Apple_scab.

Apple rust leaf.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence with Cedar apple rust.

Bell_pepper leaf spot.causal_agent: Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria vs. Cercospora capsici (frogeye leaf spot) / Alternaria
Bell_pepper leaf spot.notes: Excluded by default in strict mode: PlantVillage defines specifically Bacterial spot (Xanthomonas), whereas PlantDoc 'Bell_pepper leaf spot' aggregates generic bell pepper leaf spot photos from web search that include fungal Cercospora leaf spot.

Cherry leaf.notes: Healthy Prunus avium / Prunus cerasus leaf.

Corn Gray leaf spot.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence for maize gray leaf spot.

Corn leaf blight.notes: PlantDoc curated Corn leaf blight following APS guidelines for Northern Corn Leaf Blight.

Corn rust leaf.notes: Direct correspondence for maize common rust.

Potato leaf early blight.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence for potato early blight.

Potato leaf late blight.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence for potato late blight.

Potato leaf.notes: Present in 29-class PlantDoc Object Detection release; excluded from 27-class classification split due to <50 images.

Soyabean leaf.notes: Spelling variant ('Soyabean leaf' in PlantDoc -> 'Soybean___healthy' in PlantVillage).

Soybean leaf.notes: Normalized spelling alias for Soyabean leaf.

Squash Powdery mildew leaf.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence for cucurbit powdery mildew on squash.

Tomato Early blight leaf.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence for tomato early blight.

Tomato Septoria leaf spot.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence for tomato Septoria leaf spot.

Tomato leaf bacterial spot.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence for tomato bacterial spot.

Tomato leaf late blight.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence for tomato late blight.

Tomato mold leaf.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence for tomato leaf mold.

Tomato two spotted spider mites leaf.notes: Present in 28-class PlantDoc release (very low sample count: ~2 images).

grape leaf black rot.notes: Direct 1-to-1 correspondence for grape black rot.
